name: prime_speaker_zegana_counts_your_other_creatures
notes: M4 mapper. Printed: 'Prime Speaker Zegana enters with X +1/+1 counters on it, where X is the greatest power among other creatures you control. When Prime Speaker Zegana enters, draw cards equal to its power.' Seat 0 controls a 2/2 Bear; seat 1's 6/6 is not seat 0's. Zegana enters with two +1/+1 counters (3/3) and its trigger draws three.
